title: Senior Manager, Data Center Power & Utility Development
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary 

The Senior Manager, Energy Supply & Utility Engagement is responsible for leading utility engagement, capacity development, energy supply origination, and regional power strategy across the Americas portfolio. This role serves as the primary commercial and strategic interface between utilities, transmission providers, regulators, IPPs, renewable developers, and other energy infrastructure stakeholders to secure scalable and reliable power capacity for colocation, cloud, and AI inference data center growth. 

Responsibilities 

  • Regional Power Strategy & Capacity Management: Develop regional power strategies, capacity forecasts, and utility readiness plans supporting new builds and expansions

  • Utility Engagement & Relationship Management: Own executive-level utility relationships and advocate for data center-ready programs, tariffs, and capacity solutions

  • Data Center Development Support: Support site selection, due diligence, utility evaluations, and infrastructure planning

  • Energy Supply Origination: Evaluate and secure long-term supply through utilities, IPPs, wholesale markets, renewable developers, storage, and onsite generation

  • Creative and innovative supply solutions in coordination with Clean Energy and Innovation energy team

  • Utility Connections & Interconnection Management: Negotiate utility service, interconnection, and capacity reservation agreements

  • AI & High-Density Infrastructure: Support power strategies for AI training, AI inference, liquid cooling, and high-density deployments

  • Support onsite, Near-Site & Bridge Power Solutions: Assess generation, microgrids, fuel cells, batteries, and bridging solutions

  • Understand regulatory & Market Intelligence: Monitor large-load regulation, transmission planning, and market developments

  • Commercial Leadership: Structure commercial agreements supporting cost, reliability, and scalability objectives

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Real Estate, Development, Energy Ops, Sustainability, Construction, Legal, and Finance

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of experience in data center utility management, power development, energy infrastructure, utility engagement, or large-load interconnections

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale, colocation, cloud, digital infrastructure, or critical infrastructure projects

  • Experience negotiating utility service agreements, connection agreements, and energy supply transactions

  • Deep understanding of transmission planning, capacity management, energy markets, and utility processes

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Energy Management, or related field. MBA preferred

Hybrid Work Arrangement: This position follows a hybrid work model and is expected to be in the office a minimum of two days per week
